title: VTC Groups — List — payload
description: List the community groups the caller may see — all of them for an administrator, the visible ones for a member — optionally only those they belong to or could join. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

mine.description: Only groups the caller belongs to.

joinable.description: Only static groups with `joinPolicy` `open` or `request` the caller does not belong to.

cursor.description: An opaque continuation token from a previous response's `nextCursor`, bound to the caller and the filters; a responder MUST NOT accept a cursor it did not issue.

limit.description: The most items to return, at most 200; the responder chooses a default (50) and MAY return fewer.

Response.title: VTC Groups — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/groups/list/0.2 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/groups/list/0.2#response.

myMembership.description: The caller's own standing in the group.

nextCursor.description: Continuation token for the next page; pass it back as `cursor`. Absent on the last page — never `null`.
